$comment: Sanitization gate config for the-serial. The gate itself lives in cyborg-garden/swarm-map (docs/sanitization-gate.md); this file only says what a particular means here.
$comment_prefixes: This repo is flat: the game is top-level files, which the secrets and PII layer scans in full. The gate needs one directory prefix; .github/ is the only directory. Top-level *.md are always included in the semantic layer.

flag_examples: a real private individual written into the game or its notes
deploy details of one machine or account: hostnames, tokens, room server secrets
contact details of a private individual: personal email, phone number, home address, messaging handle or account ID
credentials, tokens, internal hostnames, server addresses or chat/group IDs of a real deployment
do_not_flag_examples: the publishing organisation and its public projects: Cyborg Garden / cyborg-garden / cyborg.garden, the former names NimbleCo / NimbleCoAI / NimbleCoOrg / nimbleco.ai, this repo's own name and GitHub URLs
the game's fictional characters, places and text
generic tool, API, library, model, provider and standard names, and public reference material
